# Twitch script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## twitch.addBlockedTerm

Adds a word or phrase to your Twitch blocked terms, so messages with it are hidden. Fails when the term is empty. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `term` | `term` | The word or phrase to block, like "buy followers". |

**Gives back:** An object with blockedTermId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addBlockedTerm", new { term = "buy followers" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_blocked_term(term="buy followers")
    ```

## twitch.addModerator

Makes a viewer a moderator in your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addModerator", new { user = "coolviewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_moderator(user="coolviewer42")
    ```

## twitch.addSuspiciousStatus

Marks a viewer as suspicious. "Active Monitoring" flags their messages for your mods; "Restricted" keeps their messages out of chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action. |
| `status` | `status` | Optional. "Active Monitoring" (the default) or "Restricted". |

**Gives back:** An object with suspiciousUser, suspiciousUserName, suspiciousUserId, suspiciousUserType, suspiciousStatusResult, suspiciousStatus (like "RESTRICTED") and suspiciousTypes.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addSuspiciousStatus", new { user = "coolviewer42", status = "Restricted" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_suspicious_status(user="coolviewer42", status="Restricted")
    ```

## twitch.ban

Bans a viewer from your Twitch chat for good. Fails when the user is not found. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action. |
| `reason` | `reason` | Optional. Why, like "Spam". |

**Gives back:** An object with bannedUser (display name), bannedUserName (login), bannedUserId, bannedUserType ("twitch") and banResult (true).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.ban", new { user = "spambot123", reason = "Spam" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_ban(user="spambot123", reason="Spam")
    ```

## twitch.configureRewards

Turns many channel point rewards on, off, paused or unpaused in one go. Fails when a name matches no reward or group. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enable` | `enable` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `disable` | `disable` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `pause` | `pause` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `unpause` | `unpause` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `disableNotConfigured` | `disable_not_configured` | Optional. true also turns off every reward that is in no reward group. Leave it out for false. |

**Gives back:** An object with rewardsChanged and rewardsSkipped (rewards Cuebot could not change).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.configureRewards", new { enable = "Hydrate!|Stretch", disable = "Games" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_configure_rewards(enable="Hydrate!|Stretch", disable="Games")
    ```

## twitch.createPoll

Starts a Twitch poll in your chat with 2 to 5 choices. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | The question, like "Which game next?" |
| `choices` | `choices` | The answers as text, one per line or separated by \|, like "Minecraft\|Fortnite\|Tetris". |
| `duration` | `duration` | Optional. How long the poll runs, in seconds (15 to 1800). Leave it out for 60. |
| `pointsPerVote` | `points_per_vote` | Optional. Channel points for each extra vote. Leave it out (or 0) to turn extra votes off. |

**Gives back:** An object with pollId and success (true).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createPoll", new { title = "Which game next?", choices = "Minecraft|Fortnite|Tetris", duration = 120 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_poll(title="Which game next?", choices="Minecraft|Fortnite|Tetris", duration=120)
    ```

## twitch.createReward

Makes a new channel point reward. Cuebot can change it later because it made it. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | The reward name, like "Hydrate!" |
| `cost` | `cost` | Optional. The price in channel points. Leave it out for 100. |
| `prompt` | `prompt` | Optional. The text viewers see under the title. |
| `inputRequired` | `input_required` | Optional. true makes viewers type a message when they redeem. Leave it out for false. |
| `enabled` | `enabled` | Optional. false makes it hidden at first. Leave it out for true. |

**Gives back:** An object with createdRewardId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createReward", new { title = "Hydrate!", cost = 500, prompt = "Make me drink some water" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_reward(title="Hydrate!", cost=500, prompt="Make me drink some water")
    ```

## twitch.getClips

Lists clips of a Twitch channel or of a category, most viewed first. Handy for a clip player. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A channel's login name or "id:12345". Leave it (and gameId) out for your own channel. |
| `gameId` | `game_id` | Optional. A category id, to get that category's clips instead of a channel's. |
| `startedAt` | `started_at` | Optional. Only clips made after this date and time, like "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z". |
| `endedAt` | `ended_at` | Optional. Only clips made before this date and time. |
| `count` | `count` | Optional. How many clips at most. Leave it out (or 0) for up to 1000. |
| `featured` | `featured` | Optional. true gives only featured clips, false only the others. Leave it out for all. |

**Gives back:** A list of clips, each with id, url, embedUrl, broadcasterName, creatorName, title, viewCount, createdAt, thumbnailUrl, duration, isFeatured and more.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.getClips", new { count = 10 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_get_clips(count=10)
    ```


## twitch.updateReward

Changes the name, text and price of a channel point reward in one go. Empty values stay as they are. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reward` | `reward` | Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed. |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The new name. Leave it empty to keep it. |
| `prompt` | `prompt` | Optional. The new text. Leave it empty to keep it. |
| `cost` | `cost` | Optional. A number. With "Set" it becomes the new price; with the other operators it changes the current price (never below 1). |
| `operator` | `operator` | Optional. "Set" (the default), "Add", "Subtract", "Multiply" or "Divide". |

**Gives back:** An object with rewardCost (the price now).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.updateReward", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["reward"] = "Hydrate!", ["cost"] = 100, ["operator"] = "Add" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_update_reward(reward="Hydrate!", cost=100, operator="Add")
    ```

## twitch.updateStreamInfo

Changes the title, category and tags of your Twitch stream in one go. Anything you leave empty stays as it is. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The new title. Leave it empty to keep it. |
| `game` | `game` | Optional. The new category or game name, like "Minecraft". Leave it empty to keep it. |
| `tags` | `tags` | Optional. New tags as text, separated by commas, like "English, Chill". Leave it empty to keep them. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.updateStreamInfo", new { title = "Building a castle", game = "Minecraft" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_update_stream_info(title="Building a castle", game="Minecraft")
    ```

## twitch.warn

Sends a viewer an official Twitch warning. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action. |
| `reason` | `reason` | The warning text they will see, like "Please keep it friendly". |

**Gives back:** An object with warnedUser (display name), warnedUserName (login), warnedUserId, warnedUserType ("twitch") and warnedResult (true).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.warn", new { user = "coolviewer42", reason = "Please keep it friendly" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_warn(user="coolviewer42", reason="Please keep it friendly")
    ```
